s.note: Welcome to Brainerd, home of Paul Bunyan
s.how: Whisk 120g flour with 200ml cold lager. Dip 300g cheese curds and fry at 185C for 60 seconds until puffed. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill and chives for ranch. Serve hot.

s.note: Marge is eating for two at the buffet
s.how: Arrange dill pickle spears, green olives, radishes, celery and carrot sticks on a tray of ice. Mix 200g sour cream with chopped dill and salt for a dip. Serve it like a church buffet, you betcha.

m.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 600g flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Shred a quarter cabbage and toss with a little mayo and vinegar. Serve with tartare.

w.note: any pie will do at the buffet
w.how: Peel and slice 1kg Granny Smith apples and toss with 120g brown sugar, 2 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp cornflour and the juice of half a lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and fill. Weave a lattice from 2 more sheets cut into strips, brush with egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest 30 minutes and serve with ice cream.

d.note: Norm's mallard makes the three-cent stamp
d.how: Brew 500ml strong coffee. Heat 500ml milk in a saucepan until steaming and whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp brown sugar until smooth. Stir in the coffee and pour into a warmed thermos. Whip 150ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp maple syrup to soft peaks. Pour into 4 mugs and spoon the cream on top.
